description: Run one natural-language forensic query over your traffic and return the result rows. One question, no memory of earlier questions; for an investigation with follow-ups use securenow_forensics_chat. Waits up to 30 seconds; a query still running after that returns its jobId with status processing. Write scope because it creates an async query job.

confirm.description: Required for write actions. Must be true.

environment.description: Deployment environment scope: production, staging, preview, local, test, or all. Default for investigations is production.

reason.description: Short human-readable reason for the write action.

name: securenow_forensics_query
title: Run Forensics Query
